questions.question: The difference between the concepts of ‘market price’ and ‘factor cost’ is primarily due to:A.DepreciationB.Net indirect taxesC.Net factor income from abroadD.Direct taxes
Which of the following is a benefit of digital technology in education?
options: It increases the cost of textbooks.
It allows all students to learn at the same pace.
It eliminates the need for teachers entirely.
It allows personalised and remote learning.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (It allows personalised and remote learning.) है।

options: To establish Buddhism as the only accepted faith
